map.局部阻力系数之和 Σξ: Sum of local resistance coefficients Σξ
map.💡 公式：流速 v = Q/(3600·π·d²/4)；沿程损失 hf = λ·: 💡 Formula: velocity v = Q/(3600·π·d²/4); friction loss hf = λ·(L/d)·(v²/2g); local loss hj = Σξ·(v²/2g); head H = (hf+hj+Δz)×(1+margin); shaft power N = ρgQH/(3600×1000×η), ρ=1000kg/m³, g=9.81m/s².
map.管径 d 输入单位为毫米(mm)，内部自动换算为米计算: Pipe diameter d is entered in millimeters (mm) and auto-converted to meters internally
map.沿程阻力系数 λ 可查莫迪图，常用镀锌钢管约 0.025~0.040，塑料管约: The friction coefficient λ can be read from the Moody chart; common galvanized steel pipe about 0.025–0.040, plastic pipe about 0.020–0.030
The sum of local resistance coefficients Σξ includes elbows, valves, tees and other fittings; with no data, use references: each elbow ≈0.7–1.5, gate valve ≈0.2, check valve ≈2.0–2.5
map.高差 Δz 为出水口与进水口液面高差，供水方向取正，回水/下行取负: Elevation difference Δz is the level difference between the outlet and inlet surfaces; positive for supply (up) direction, negative for return / down
map.计算结果为估算值，实际选型请以厂家水泵性能曲线为准并校核汽蚀余量: Results are estimates; for actual selection follow the manufacturer's pump performance curve and verify the net positive suction head
map.📚 深度解析：水泵扬程与轴功率核算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Verifying Pump Head and Shaft Power
map.按管路沿程、局部阻力与高差算总扬程，加裕量选泵。: Compute total head from pipe friction, local resistance and elevation, add margin and select the pump.
map.由流量、扬程、效率算轴功率配电机。: From flow, head and efficiency, compute shaft power to size the motor.
map.变频运行按实际流量点重算功率节能。: For VFD operation, recompute power at the actual flow point for energy savings.
map.轴功率 N = 1000×9.81×(50/3600)×120 ÷ (1000×: Shaft power N = 1000×9.81×(50/3600)×120 ÷ (1000×0.70) ≈ 2.33 kW, select a 3 kW motor; add head margin of 5%–10%.
map.效率 70%→80%，同参数功率由 2.33 降到 2.04 kW，长期运行省电: Efficiency 70%→80%, same parameters power drops from 2.33 to 2.04 kW, saving considerable electricity over long runs.
map.总扬程 = 沿程损失 + 局部损失 + 几何高差，再乘 1.05~1.10 裕量: Total head = friction loss + local loss + geometric elevation, then multiply by 1.05–1.10 margin to avoid sizing too close to the limit.
